methods.name: bfloat16 mixed-precision training

methods.description: Used for parallel training with adjustable ZeRO stages to fit GPU memory.

methods.description: Self-attention CUDA kernels used for efficiency.

methods.name: Mistral-7B
methods.description: Language model whose parameter weight distributions are analyzed
